name: Microsoft Entra ID Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) configurations. Covers tenant configuration, user and group management, conditional access policies, app registrations, service principals, privileged identity management (PIM), and Entra ID-specific attack paths.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Entra ID security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Entra ID concepts including tenants, principals, and conditional access
evidence: Can explain Entra ID tenants, users, groups, and service principals
Understands app registrations and OAuth consent frameworks
Familiar with conditional access policy concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Entra ID configurations under supervision using established tools
evidence: Runs Entra ID enumeration tools (e.g., ROADtools, AzureHound) under guidance
Reviews conditional access policies against lab checklists
Documents Entra ID findings with supervision; work reviewed by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Entra ID security posture and identifies attack paths
evidence: Independently enumerates and reviews tenant-wide Entra ID configurations
Identifies privilege escalation through app registration abuse and consent grants
Evaluates PIM configurations and standing admin access risks
Produces compliant Entra ID assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-tenant assessments; discovers novel Entra ID attack paths; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-tenant, B2B collaboration and Entra External ID configurations, treating Azure AD B2C as legacy
Develops custom tooling for Entra ID enumeration and attack path analysis
Reviews Entra ID assessment work of junior analysts
Identifies novel attack chains through Entra ID misconfigurations

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Entra ID assessment methodology; publishes research on Entra ID attack techniques
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Entra ID security assessment framework
Published research on novel Entra ID attack techniques or defense bypasses
Trains teams on advanced Entra ID security assessment
Recognized as internal or external authority on Entra ID security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured Entra ID tenant and identify all privilege escalation and lateral movement paths
Review Entra ID assessment findings from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy

cis: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 5 Identity Services
